summary: Iteration 6 validated the new SkillMatch surfaces: EventDetail route, apply-button state contract (Apply/Applied/Accepted/Completed), discover filters (skill/department/type/date), new event fields (duration/department/event_type), seats_available derivation, organizer-ownership enforcement for /applications & /complete, and toasts for apply/profile/cert download. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6.py — 6/6 PASS. Frontend: live preview Playwright run covered organizer create (new fields), volunteer apply from Discover + from EventDetail (toast + button text transition Apply→Applied, disabled), filter bar interactions (skill filter reduced count 2→1, clear-filters-button resets), back-to-list-button, organizer accept toast, mark complete flow, volunteer card button becomes 'Completed' + disabled, EventDetail apply button also shows 'Completed', certificate-download-* link produces toast 'Downloading … certificate…', profile-save-button produces toast 'Profile updated.', event delete flow. Mobile viewports 360/390/430: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth at all 3 sizes).
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is now 1424 lines — strongly recommend splitting EventDetail / EventCard / CreateEventModal into their own files before next iteration.
Complete flow uses window.prompt() for hours/notes — accessible-UX risk. Replace with an in-app modal for better consistency with other create/profile modals.
Backend event_payload runs applications.find per event in a loop (N+1 on GET /api/events). Fine at current scale but should be refactored to a single aggregate once events > ~50.
`_derive_type` fallback uses substring matches ('fest'/'green'/etc.) — only triggered for legacy events; new events always carry event_type. Document that this is best-effort.
test_credentials: maya/maya1234 (volunteer), campusadmin/admin1234 (organizer) — working. Created transient test_org_b/pass1234 (organizer) for ownership tests.
seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_Iter6_* events created and deleted during Playwright + pytest runs. One secondary organizer `test_org_b` is now persisted (used only for 403 ownership tests). No prod data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suites in /app/backend/tests/: test_iteration6.py (new fields + seats + ownership), test_insights.py, test_enhancements.py, test_security_fixes.py, test_skillmatch_api.py. On live preview DB only `hackathon` seed event survives (iteration-5 artifact). Volunteer `maya` already has 1 completed cert for `hackathon` + whatever test events this run completed/deleted. If you need to test 'rejected' state transition specifically, create a new event, apply, then PATCH /api/applications/{eid}/maya status=rejected and check EventCard button says 'Not selected' (applyLabel handles it in App.js:578). The complete flow uses window.prompt — in Playwright, register a dialog handler before clicking complete-{username}-button and feed hours then notes.
